hints.title: Simulation Rules
hints.text: If the current number is even, divide it by 2; otherwise, subtract 1.

hints.title: Bitwise Representation
hints.text: Dividing by 2 shifts bits right by 1. Subtracting 1 clears the least significant bit.

hints.title: Count Set Bits and Length
hints.text: Total steps equals total bit length minus 1 plus the count of 1 bits, when num > 0.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulation already runs in logarithmic steps; there is no failure mode.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Straightforward loop runs in O(log N) iterations with zero memory overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate implements clean simulation or uses bit count arithmetic.
complexity.notes: Every odd step takes 1 operation (subtract 1), every even step takes 1 operation (halve).
